email.subject: Brightpath Analytics: interview for the Data Engineer role
email.body:
Hi,

Thank you for applying for the Data Engineer role at Brightpath Analytics. We enjoyed reading your application and would like to invite you to a first interview with our data platform team.

The interview is a 45-minute video call on Thursday, 5 November 2026 at 14:00 (Istanbul time). You'll meet Tom, our data platform lead, and we'll talk about your experience with pipelines and the work on our team. A Zoom link will follow in a separate email.

Please reply to confirm that the time works for you.

Best regards,
Maya Collins
Talent Partner
